sentences.text: If you light a fire on a tall tower, you have a lighthouse.
But the wind on top blows the flame out.
So you close the flame inside a glass room.
But now its glow is weak and spreads every way.
So you add a lens, invented in 1822, that bends it into one beam.
The lens turns, and its beam is seen about 20 miles out to sea.
But now the heavy lens grinds as it turns.
So you float it on liquid mercury, and it spins easily.
Add stairs to the door and rocks to complete it.
Congratulations, you have built a lighthouse.
